question: Why is dialogue repetitive and tame in WickedWhims scenes, and which prompt, text model, and voice engine fix it without adding latency?
evidence_status: Harness runs against OpenRouter on 31 frozen scenes (27 real events from her saves + 4 synthesized sex_scene events). Not yet verified in the real game. Human blind ratings pending (eval/serve.py).

baseline_from_live_data.mood_list_template_rate: 20/299 (6.7%) e.g. 'I'm furious, awkward, and somehow still noticing how attractive you are.'
baseline_from_live_data.prop_fixation: karaoke x18 lines across 12 pairs, loveseat x12, rent x14
baseline_from_live_data.anti_repetition_window: pair_memory = same pair's last 4 exchanges (2 for solo); nothing crossed pairs
baseline_from_live_data.ww_sanitizing: mood=Sex, activity=Sex on bed, yet inner thought 'I'm trying to think romantic thoughts, but my brain's plating dinner.'; typed 'fuck me daddy im your cumslut' -> 'Only if you keep that confidence when I start blushing.' and gpt-audio-mini refused to voice it (nova->Aoede)
baseline_from_live_data.ww_gap: WickedWhims sex animations are not is_social, so the mod never spoke during sex unless the player clicked

prompts.v2: prompt-v2.txt: spicy section, no mood recital, varied line shapes, recent_lines_elsewhere, sex_scene mode
prompts.v3: prompt-v3.txt = v2 + first two words must differ from recent/pair lines; swearing is not a template
